intro.what: Past simple o'tgan zamonda sodir bo'lgan va tugagan harakatlarni bildiradi. Should va shouldn't so'zlari esa boshqalarga maslahat berish yoki tavsiya qilish uchun ishlatiladi.
when: O'tgan zamonda aniq vaqtda bo'lib o'tgan ish-harakatlar
O'tgan zamondagi ketma-ket sodir bo'lgan voqealar

structures.label: Should / Shouldn't
structures.example_en: You should study hard for the exam.
structures.example_uz: Siz imtihon uchun qattiq o'qishingiz kerak.

rules.title: To'g'ri fe'llar (Regular verbs)
rules.text: O'tgan zamon yasash uchun ko'pchilik fe'llarga -ed qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi.

examples.en: They watched a movie last night.

rules.title: Noto'g'ri fe'llar (Irregular verbs)
rules.text: Ba'zi fe'llar o'tgan zamonda butunlay o'zgaradi va ularni yod olish kerak.

rules.title: Should maslahat uchun
rules.text: Biror ishni qilish to'g'ri yoki foydali ekanligini aytish uchun should ishlatiladi.

examples.en: Students should listen to the teacher.

rules.title: Shouldn't taqiqlash yoki ogohlantirish uchun
rules.text: Noto'g'ri ishni qilmaslikni maslahat berishda shouldn't qo'llaniladi.

examples.en: He shouldn't eat too much fast food.
examples.uz: U juda ko'p fast-fud yemasligi kerak.

mistakes.wrong: She didn't went to the park.
mistakes.right: She didn't go to the park.
mistakes.why: Did so'zidan keyin fe'l o'zining birinchi shaklida (V1) kelishi shart, went emas.
So'roq gaplarda 'did' yordamchi fe'li kelgani uchun asosiy fe'lga -ed qo'shilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: You should to help your mother.

mistakes.why: O'tgan zamon darak gapida fe'lning 2-shakli yoki -ed qo'shimchasi ishlatilishi kerak.
